purpose: What produced this corpus. Every meta.json carries nodeAppCommit + oracleDigest; the full block lives here. A rebuild that changes an expected.json without changing any field below is a genuine non-determinism and must be investigated, not re-recorded.

sourcePinning.note: nodeAppCommit + packageLockSha256 identify the transform under test; oracleDigest identifies the harness. A regeneration that changes any expected.json without changing one of these three is a genuine non-determinism and must be investigated, not re-recorded.

contractClassification.note: Each case declares contract.status. IN_CONTRACT means the input satisfies the published schema and the recorded output is a PARITY OBLIGATION. SCHEMA_INVALID and PRODUCER_IMPLAUSIBLE mean the producer cannot emit the input: the recording is real evidence of what the Node app does, but the Java port's behaviour there is a design decision, most likely dead-lettering as a contract violation. Partition the corpus on this field before asserting.

baseFixtureCaveat: Base fixtures are the function app's own Jest fixtures, copied byte-identical. They are TRIMMED test data: six of the thirteen carry a courtCentre without the required `name` (courtCentre.json required is ["id","name"]), and none was validated against the published schema when it was written. A variant's contract.status classifies THE MUTATION, not the base it is applied to.
subscriptionSchemaCaveat: cpp-context-reference-data/referencedata-query/referencedata-query-api/src/raml/json/schema/referencedata.query.get-now-subscriptions.json is internally inconsistent (additionalProperties:false alongside required entries that are not declared as properties); classifications use only its unambiguous parts.
